messages:
Rina B: spun up a 0.5% canary for redwood-v3q4 on /codegen. low traffic slice but high-sensitivity for behavioural changes. quick watch please.
Jon P: noted. any initial metrics?
Rina B: p50/p95 latency fine. p99 slightly +80ms. more concerning: output-length variance increased on 'autocomplete-heavy' slice and a tiny spike in repeated token sequences.
Sam K: can you link the perf panel?
Rina B: https://console.redwood/graphs/xyz - see slice filters. variance metric is new; we estimated baseline sigma and are seeing +12% stdev on generated length.
Jon P: hmm. length variance can mean tokenization or EOS handling shifted by quant kernels. do we have a dedupe/rep-detection signal in rollout checks?
Rina B: not currently enforced automatically. we have a manual monitor but not a hard gate. that's what i'm proposing: a "behavioural_stability" gate that includes dedupe_rate, output_length_std, and semantic-similarity drift for a small set of eval prompts.
Sam K: sounds reasonable. what thresholds? we should pick conservative defaults: dedupe > 0.7% abs OR length_std > +10% relative OR semantic-sim (embed cosine) drop > 0.8% abs in critical slices triggers auto-fallback.
Jon P: agree on conservative. also recommend tying weight of each signal by slice impact score (legal/docs higher weight), and require either a single hard signal OR two weaker signals to trigger.
Rina B: proposed rule encoded: if (hard_signal) OR (sum(weighted_soft_signals) >= 1.0) then rollback. hard_signal = dedupe_inc > 1.0% OR semantic_drop > 1.2% OR p99_lat_delta > 180ms. soft signals: length_std_rel, rouge_delta_small, token_shift_rate.
eng-bot: rollout-bot: canary redwood-v3q4 started at 1739991111 route=["/codegen"] size=0.5%
Sam K: before we flip this to auto-fallback, we should add a preflight: replay 2k samples and run static prefix-consistency check + embed-diff baseline. also increase shadowing from 1%->5% for 4h.
Rina B: running replay now, will post diff summary. also adding a small unit test into the CI harness that fails if prefix hashes differ between baseline/variant for identical inputs.
Jon P: don't forget to account for tokenizer merges causing off-by-one tokens on long contexts; include tokenized-length histogram in report.
eng-bot: replay-job: replay-1739991111 started against baseline+v3q4, samples=2000, expected runtime ~8m
Rina B: replay results: dedupe_inc 0.35% overall, but autocomplete-heavy slice = 0.95% (below hard 1.0%); length_std_rel +11% on that slice; embed_cos_drop 0.9% abs.
Sam K: combined soft-signal weight for that slice ~1.2 -> would have triggered our soft-sum threshold. given that + small p99 bump, i'm leaning toward rollback and investigate tokenization/quant rounding.
Jon P: agreed, rollback and file runtime ticket for quant-kernel rounding. we should also capture full tokenization trace for failing examples.
Rina B: rolling back now on /codegen. will annotate the rollout with replay artifacts and candidate diffs.
eng-bot: rollout-bot: rollback executed for redwood-v3q4 on /codegen at 1739991422 by @Rina B
Sam K: follow-ups: 1) add behavioural_stability gate to rollout config (default ON for codegen/docs slices), 2) CI preflight for prefix/hash, 3) increase shadowing during re-onboard and 4) long-term: integrate embed-based semantic checks into fast rollouts.
Rina B: noted. i'll open PR for config + a small RFC for semantic checks. thanks all.
